title: Client Testimonials
content:
★★★★★
“We had an amazing experience working with Frank as first-time homebuyers! He listened to what we wanted and helped us find the perfect home in our price range. Frank made sure we understood everything, provided honest advice, and was extremely responsive. He helped us secure an amazing deal during a competitive market. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Frank to anyone looking to buy or sell their home!”— Sara, Grosse Pointe Farms
★★★★★
“Frank did an outstanding job helping us buy our house. It was a long process due to a complicated market, and he was on our side every step of the way. He’s very responsive and always has his clients' best interests in mind!”— Hannah, Bloomfield Hills
★★★★★
“Frank was great throughout the entire process. As a first-time homebuyer, he was very patient with me and helped me understand everything we were working through. I felt comfortable trusting his judgment as we toured houses and devised strategies. I can't thank him enough!”— Jack, Grosse Pointe Park
★★★★★
“Just outstanding all around. If you’re searching, especially for a home in Grosse Pointe, and not using Frank or Sine & Monaghan, then you’re out of the game. Responsive, friendly, kind, and seriously business-minded.”— Jonathan, Grosse Pointe Shores
★★★★★
“Frank is beyond any expectation you may have. He leaves no details unaddressed. We had a very tangled and complex situation and could not have navigated the sale/purchase without him. If you do not employ Frank, you are losing out!”— Jeff, Grosse Pointe
★★★★★
“Frank was meticulous and on top of any issue that arose. I will recommend him whenever possible!”— Joy, Grosse Pointe Park
★★★★★
“Frank did an amazing job selling my home and helping me find a new one. I couldn’t ask for anyone more caring or hardworking when it comes to real estate.”— Angie
★★★★★
“Frank was on top of everything 24/7. He never dropped the ball. Whenever I needed something or had questions, he responded immediately.”— John, Sterling Heights
★★★★★
“Being randomly connected with Frank through Zillow was one of the most fortunate blessings I have ever received. To say he went above and beyond as a Realtor is an understatement. He is knowledgeable, well-connected in the community, and understands client needs before even being asked. Our Grosse Pointe Farms home all happened because of him!”— Jeffrey, Grosse Pointe Farms
